title: UAI Transparency Receipt
description: Proof that a signed statement is at a given index of the append-only log. A statement plus its receipt is self-contained: verifying it needs no UAI service, which is the point — evidence must survive the disappearance of its issuer.

inclusion_proof.description: RFC 6962 audit path, root-ward. May be empty for a single-leaf tree.

witness_signatures.description: Independent co-signatures. Witnesses are what makes a split view impossible to hide: showing two verifiers different histories requires witness signatures over inconsistent checkpoints, and an honest witness refuses.

anchor.description: Absent until the checkpoint is anchored on-chain. A verifier MUST be able to express VERIFIED_UNANCHORED rather than silently treating an unanchored statement as fully verified.
